_note: Extra book map pages for walks whose route continues past the walk's first map. Pins are read off these pages the same way (map_stops.json, controls.json, keyed by the page id). A stop already placed from the walk's first map keeps that pin. 'confidence' overrides 'book' when a page is too schematic to trust street-level positions. Rendered at 110 dpi into scripts/georef/pages/ by pages.py; not shown in the app.
